parsed.why: Sodomy criminalised, no recognition, closed civic space and hostile officials, yet no trans-specific offence or documented targeting; Pride with police escort and inclusive health policy partly offset, but outing offers no remedy.

No trans criminalisation and courts that work for trans people (annulled zones, HRT damages, non-binary discrimination ruling), but violent counter-protests, state hostility, no gender-identity hate-crime cover, and a documented male-centre detention with HRT cut off.

Self-ID, self-determined facility access, enforced hate-crime aggravation with actual sentences, official tourism protections and strong acceptance; only regional repeals of resident-facing laws and conservative attitudes outside big cities pull it below the top tier.

Constitutional gender-identity equality and court relief coexist with real traveller-facing friction: airport stop of a trans passenger, passport medical-exam demands, railway police groping 'gender checks' and degrading custody, plus the 2026 recognition rollback and lost sexual-violence safeguards.

Criminalised cross-dressing and sodomy carrying up to life, no legal recognition, documented official extrajudicial killings and torture, vigilante targeting, fatwa-blocked care and no functioning recourse; thin enforcement data extrapolates from this hostile structure.
